'''Sebastian''' (Japanese: '''セバスチャン''' ''Sebastian'') is a minor recurring character of {{aniseries|RS}}, who appeared in ''[[AG110|The Great Eight Fate!]]'' and ''[[AG111|Eight Ain't Enough]]''. He is the assistant for the [[Sootopolis Gym]], as well as [[Juan]]'s butler. 

He formally greeted {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} as they arrived with Juan at the Sootopolis Gym's dock. Sebastian guided Ash to his battle podium, and then served as the [[Battle judge|referee]] for Ash's [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}} against Juan.

Later on, Sebastian congratulated Ash on his victory and informed him about the location of the [[Ever Grande Conference]], which will be held in three months' time.
